blurb: Sun & Ski Sports offers snowboard and ski gear sales, expert tuning, mounting, waxing, and repairs. They provide lifetime services on equipment purchased from them, including unlimited belt wax and base & edge prep. Locations include Fort Worth, Austin, Katy, and Dillon, with expert advice tailored to rider needs and local mountain recommendations.
extraNote: Lifetime Services apply only to items purchased at Sun & Ski Sports · No online or in-store registration required for Lifetime Services; use phone or email from purchase · Discounts on minor damage from regular use; major damage or warranty issues handled by local store
